formal.anchor: Q1 options: A alone (inherits Zero/reduction/bridge/zoom family, FR-001, V2's two OQ-4 witnesses; orphans v1.2 evaluation family, loses the reason channel) | B alone (inherits the 26 v1.2 experiments; orphans the reduction ladder) | C alone (the only estate speaking the ratified vocabulary; orphans both experimental families) | A+B+C with declared seams (everything currently executed; two seam contracts become obligations) | KS=(X,A) conceptual (a clean measure-theoretic envelope; 6 files, 0 code; orphans all three estates unless declared as an envelope). No recommendation is offered on Q1.

governance.anchor: Q4 -- not decided: kernel selection (O_core present in 51% of 66 worlds; any minimality claim inherits a coin flip; both registers put selection last); O_core (NOT FROZEN, membership rule absent); Theory v1.3 (governance order is EXPERIMENT->AUDIT->ADJUDICATION->v1.3, adjudication has not happened); OQ-2/DECISION-02 (a separate decision, gates composition and delta, not the carrier); the five conflict records (Contr, >=, delta, ≡_sem, Qualify); any new algebra (negative results; Zero is not an element property); Gita candidacy (closed, Theory 13 §6); every glyph collision (explicitly out of scope per Governance -- only the carrier vocabulary and citations needed to identify the ratified object; the remaining ~45 definitions across 15 glyphs are a subsequent normalization task, H1).

lexical.anchor: Correction to V1 -- there are THREE implemented carriers, not two. V1 reported two code estates and stated that the ratified eight primitives have '0 lines of code.' Both are wrong. Measured by class definitions: A verification/zero-algebra/ 59 .py -- Case, Rec(v,s,t,rank), Rep(cls,items), Item(...); B research/knowledgeos-sim/ 55 .py -- EVal, Arg, State, Boundary, World, StructuredModel; C verification/**/exec/ 54 .py, 5723 LOC -- class K, Assertion(id,P,e,c,t,sigma), Proposition(entity,dimension,value), Observation, Evidence, Provenance, Op. Carrier C implements BOTH K=(A,R) AND ratified-primitive types. The ratified vocabulary is IMPLEMENTED. V1's '0 lines of code' is withdrawn.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Three estates of near-identical size -- 59/55/54 .py. This is not an estate with one carrier and some sketches. It is three parallel implementations of comparable maturity, and OQ-1's real content is which of them the theory speaks about.
rationale_evidence.statement: Characterizes the corpus as having three parallel implementations of genuinely comparable maturity rather than one carrier with sketches, reframing OQ-1's substantive content as choosing which implementation the theory actually refers to.

rationale_evidence.statement: Ranks all nine corpus definitions of K/K-script/K-blackboard by citation count, result-bearing-file count, and code presence, finding two definitions (K=(A,R) and the ratified K_t) dominate with 119 of 165 result-bearing files and are the only two implemented in code, while one (K-blackboard=(Sigma,M,B,D,O,delta)) has zero results anywhere and is flagged as a clean rejection candidate; all nine statuses are marked with a '?' as candidate classifications only, since assigning final status is the governance act.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Q3: two seams, and only two: A<->B, what does an evaluator receive from a representation? -- the reason channel -- A says what was removed, only B says why; demanded independently by KR-CONTR-FDE's two boundary collapses and KR-CONTR-EVAL's 'no flat domain of any cardinality is adequate; the minimum is a pair with an indispensable reason component.' C<->(A,B): is K=(A,R) the state that A's representations represent and B's evaluations evaluate? (A,R)=_semantic pi_K(K_t) -- lossy, definable-not-computable; replay/policy-eval/authorize unanswerable in (A,R). A ratification that names a carrier and leaves these two seams undeclared produces a formally ratified carrier whose relationship to every executed result is unstated.
rationale_evidence.statement: Identifies exactly two seam contracts requiring explicit declaration regardless of which carrier arrangement is chosen: the A<->B 'reason channel' seam (evaluators need why, not just what, per two independently-demanded findings) and the C<->(A,B) projection seam ((A,R)=_semantic pi_K(K_t), a lossy, definable-but-not-computable projection under which replay/policy-eval/authorize are unanswerable); warns that leaving either seam undeclared produces a ratified carrier disconnected from its own executed results.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Carriers DEFINED but carrying no executed result (10-row table): KS=(X,A) measurable epistemic state space, 20 files, none executed; K=(A,R) the verification lane's kernel, 98 files, kos_kernel.py 29 experiments -- executed; ratified K_t over 8 primitives, 41 files, no code; K_t=(A_t,E_t,R_t,C_t,H_t,Gamma_t) 6 fields, 7 files, none; Theory-01 D,T,R,Q,Pi,O,C,E_S, 121 files, = Carrier A's vocabulary -- executed; Sigma 5-axis 2240 states, 112 files, partly executed, 0 of 5 axes ordered; D_t varying dimension set, 18 files, none, population rule blocked; G_t=(V,E,Phi) attributed multigraph, 5 files, none, its convergence theorem found invalid; h_Lambda=(H,R_sem,Lambda,Sigma_Lambda) FR-001's [PROP] successor, 7 files, none; Hilbert-space representation KR-HILBERT, 37 files, negative result (PARTIALLY CONFIRMED weakest sense, H1/H3/H7/H8 refuted). Ten candidates. THREE carry executed results. Two of those three are Carriers A and B.
rationale_evidence.statement: Tabulates ten total carrier candidates found across the corpus, of which only three carry any executed result (K=(A,R)/Carrier A's kernel, Theory-01's vocabulary matching Carrier A, and the negative Hilbert-space result), with the ratified K_t itself among the seven with no executed result.
